  case={'family':fixture['family'],'role':fixture['role'],'lanes':B,'message_bytes':len(fixture['native']['json']),
   'native_checkpoint_sha256':hashlib.sha256(fixture['serialized'].encode()).hexdigest(),'source_buffer_sha256':before,'native_state_key':fixture['native']['state_key'],'native_engine_key':fixture['native']['engine_key'],'pairs':[],'fenced_substages':{}}
  for pair in range(6):

   for mode in order:
    with patch.object(unit,'_library',libraries[mode]):
     torch.mps.synchronize();now=time.perf_counter();result=identities(formatter,state,byte_capacity=config.byte_capacity,digest_implementation='unrolled');torch.mps.synchronize();row['seconds'][mode]=time.perf_counter()-now
    check_identity(result,expected,fixture['native'],fixture['outer'],B)
    del result
   case['pairs'].append(row);policy.completed(2)
  for mode in ('ulong','uint'):
   stages={}

    result=identities(formatter,state,byte_capacity=config.byte_capacity,digest_implementation='unrolled',stages=stages,synchronize=torch.mps.synchronize,clock=time.perf_counter)
   check_identity(result,expected,fixture['native'],fixture['outer'],B);case['fenced_substages'][mode]=stages
  case['source_unchanged']=resident_digest(state)==before and raw.serialize()==fixture['serialized'];require(case['source_unchanged'],'Source changed')
